scope: Independent CPU-only existing video decode, visual inspection, and light final report/CSV/summary/manifest consistency review; parent performs full numerical/raw-artifact audit
visual_review_notes: All 12 existing paired MP4 files fully decoded. First, midpoint and final decoded frame inspected for every file using six real-frame contact sheets; drawer and peg first-failure final frames additionally inspected at native 960x558 resolution.

Visible simulator scenes show the expected distinct task geometry and changing robot/object poses. First frame in each pair has visibly matched starting layout. Native-size overlays are readable and identify task, candidate, N20, C/E split, step/physical time, numerical goal, episode_success and route/phase.

All six first-failure files visibly retain episode_success=0 for B0. Assembly first-failure retains failure on both sides. Drawer failure has visually opened drawer but recorded success=0 due to success_threshold_with_joint_violation; this is a scoring condition, not missing motion.

Successful shorter trajectories explicitly say final held while the other side proceeds. The 1.0–6.3 second durations match decoded 20 fps frame counts; they are physical-time replays rather than slowed presentation.

All 14 final test PNGs were opened and visually inspected: six per-task IID/C/E curves, six sampled-factor coverage plots, one signed OOD delta heatmap, one optional-feedback comparison. Titles, axis units, candidate legends and initial-selected development-only wording are readable.

Heatmap preserves negative candidate effects and marks unrun P4 cells NA. Feedback graph shows only peg-insert-side P4 data and its lower OOD than initial-selected at N5 and N20. Main per-task plots contain only initial B0/P1/P2/P3 and initial-selected.

Figure numerical curves and representative heatmap extrema agree visually with the all-results table; all 98 Markdown candidate rows independently match summary JSON values and Wilson intervals, and all CSV fields match the same JSON. Raster plots are not independently numerically inverted.

Coverage legends sit within the N20 panels and obscure a small part of their point region; the N2/N5/N10 panels show the same fixed test points without legends. This is a minor presentation limitation and does not alter the underlying coverage records.
No training, policy inference, simulator replay, source modification or existing artifact rewriting was performed for this review.
